info.description: Read-only MaudeSignal tools for a Meta Muse connector. Each answer has a short speakable summary, facts that each carry an openFDA or record link, a fixed advisory line and provenance (stored demo snapshot with dates, or live openFDA with the query time). Advisory triage aid for quality and regulatory review; not medical advice; nothing is filed with FDA. Every key is read-only. Sentences from ask are checked by a deterministic claim gate; withheld sentences are listed separately and are never part of the speakable text. Limits: the per-key rate limit and the per-key daily cost cap are shared by every server instance when an Upstash Redis store is configured (GET /v1/health says which); otherwise they live in each instance's memory and temporary storage, are per instance and reset on a cold start. In that case live Muse Spark answers stay switched off unless the operator sets an explicit per-instance override; ask then returns the closest recorded answer, labelled recorded. Repeated wrong keys from one address get 429. /v1/public/check_device_type needs no key (per-address limit, six-hour cache) and never calls the model.
info.title: MaudeSignal connector API

get.description: Read-only. The last entries (default 20, at most 200) of the append-only, hash-chained log of tool calls: tool, inputs, answer SHA-256, gate counts, provenance and the caller's label (if any) and key id (a keyed hash held by the server; never the key). An `ask` question is stored as its SHA-256 and length, not its text. Full keys only: the public demo key gets 403. `chain.verified` is recomputed on every call.
get.summary: Most recent audit entries, with the chain re-checked

get.description: Where the MCP and REST endpoints are, which header carries the key, the public demo key (when the operator has set one) with its lower limits, and three steps. The demo key is public by design, works on every read tool and never starts a live model call.

Read-only, no API key. The same answer as check_device_type plus `check`, the figures behind it: classification, change, counts, shares, window and the openFDA queries (label, url). openFDA is queried from the server, with the server's own openFDA key and the MaudeSignal user agent. Limits: a per-address limit (default 10 per hour) and a six-hour cache per product code. Browsers may call it only from origins listed by the operator (no wildcard). It never calls the model.

Give what you read from a device photo or label (device_name, model, manufacturer, k_number, udi or gtin, product_code; at least one) and get up to 3 possible FDA records from openFDA (510(k), registration & listing, UDI), each with why_matched and why_not_matched, plus this week's change, recent recalls and the report count for the top product code, each with its openFDA link. status is needs_person_to_confirm, no_match_found or search_failed. `confirmed` is always null: a person confirms one record, or none.
